title: Creamy rice porridge with warm grapes

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Pudding rice, milk, almonds, grapes, honey, cinnamon and lemon are all plain cupboard and fridge foods.

supermarket.reason: Every item is a standard Tesco line at an everyday price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a heavy pan and a frying pan, and the technique is simple simmering and toasting.

works.reason: 150g pudding rice in 1.3 litres of liquid for 30 to 35 minutes gives a creamy porridge for four, and the honeyed grapes and almonds balance it.

honest_times.reason: Halving the grapes, chopping and toasting the almonds and warming the fruit fit within 15 minutes alongside a 35-minute simmer, which matches the step.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: Warm grapes are the topping that makes the dish, and a warm porridge suits an early September morning.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Milk, rice, fruit and almonds make a filling breakfast with only a tablespoon of honey across four bowls.
